about: The sprites and sprite swaps of the politics, diplomacy, decision and peace conference windows and the standard diplomatic popup (UI overhaul lane W2, docs/plans/ui_overhaul/02_plan.md phase 2; design system docs/specs/07_interface/07_design_system.md sections 1.3, 5, 6, 7; K69, K70: these windows are Chancery). Vanilla shares its chrome textures across areas, so one replaced texture can carry one theme only (renders/C1/theme_conflicts.json: the peace conference drew eight Banner Hall and Chronicle textures, the politics view its tiled Banner Hall body and the pixel-doubled lower border). Each window here draws its own sprites, cut by modules/ui_chancery.mjs (with the cutter of modules/ui_dialogs.mjs) from accepted lane C1 chrome sheets: code only crops, reduces, repeats and places generated pixels. The overrides are the installed vanilla files with sprite names swapped; every element name and position is kept.

notes.size: A cornered body (size minus twice the border) is a prime length that fits inside the reduced cell (window 113, section 173, inset and reading 109, plate 73, body 61): the fitter may only repeat a period that divides the engine body, and with a prime body that period is the whole body, so a large panel shows one quiet join per tile instead of a short brick-like repeat.
notes.kind: cornered: a corneredTileSpriteType the engine stretches (size and border are the engine values); sprite: a spriteType of fixed size; strip: a spriteType of fixed size with one frame per cell (noOfFrames, no button effect, as the vanilla entry strips); button: a spriteType with one frame per state (normal, hover, pressed) and the button effect.
notes.roles: window: a window body with the bronze moulding; section: a bordered sub-panel; inset: a recessed well for lists and grids; plate: a quiet panel for text in the light faces; reading: cream vellum for long reading text in the ink face.
